title: Circle, Square, Circle: Find the Ring | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
A square, a circle, a smaller square, a smaller circle, like nesting dolls! Vantee finds the area of the shaded ring two ways: find each radius, or fold and turn to a shrunk copy.
We also look at the wrong-answer traps and a one-level-deeper challenge to try yourself.
